## Changes

- Add Malayalam and Kannada to language preferences, stream sorting and profile onboarding.
- Ask whether the display is 4K once per account/device instead of per profile. Keep display quality, format and tunneling overrides local to that device, separate from cloud profile settings.
- Add Hide Unwatched Episode Spoilers in Playback settings, enabled by default. Blur unwatched episode artwork and collapse descriptions, with an explicit description reveal option.
- Fix the download-progress formatting exception and handle OK/Enter safely on Diagnostics log cards. Safeguard focus movement to off-screen diagnostic entries.

## Verification

172 local JVM tests passed, including verification against the signed APK. Release lint has no errors. Instrumentation sources compiled; physical TV and two-device/cloud behavior still require device validation.

Signed 32-bit armeabi-v7a build for Android 8.0 and newer, using the existing Saab TV release key. Install over the previous version without uninstalling. Existing installations will be asked once to configure their display; changing the display type resets local display overrides.
